articles.summary: Ms. Francis is MGP’s President and Chief Executive Officer and a member of MGP’s board of directors. As Chief Executive Officer, Ms. Francis oversees the company’s global business strategy and operations, leveraging more than three decades of experience across the branded food and beverage industries. Ms. Francis joined MGP in July 2025.
articles.title: Julie Francis
MGP INGREDIENTS APPOINTS JULIE FRANCIS AS CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
